prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Cooper Hewitt and reading text in Inter; architectural sans heading with neutral interface text. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
